description: Figure 7 presents the distribution of articles across media outlets for the years 2017, 2018, 2019, and 2020. The chart consists of four slices, each representing a year. The 2019 slice is blue and represents approximately 46.0% (40) of the total. The 2018 slice is also blue and represents approximately 33.0% (29). The 2020 slice is light blue and represents approximately 21.0% (18). Finally, the 2017 slice is light blue and represents approximately 20.0% (17). The chart includes a legend identifying the years and their corresponding colors, as well as percentage and count labels inside each slice. The slices are visually ordered clockwise, starting with 2019 and proceeding to 2018, 2020, and 2017.
